content.title: What time will Invincible season 4 be released on Prime Video?
content.text: It's almost time for Mark Grayson's (Steven Yeun) return in Invincible season 4!The upcoming instalment will follow Mark as he and the rest of the world recover from the devastating events of season 3.But massive new threats are incoming, including the long-awaited General Thragg (voiced by Lee Pace), plus a completely original story involving returning character Damien Darkblood.Speaking exclusively to Radio Times, co-showrunner Robert Kirkman said: "We always change things and enhance things and lengthen stories and shorten stories, so there’s a lot of big differences in this show. But to have something that's completely original and completely new, you know, hasn't happened a lot in the series up to this point."And so this is something that you know is wholly original to the show. And I think that's going to be really cool, how it fits into the story, and how it weaves into the overall tapestry of the Viltrumite War. You'll just have to find out."More like thisBut what time will new episodes of the show come our way? Here's what we know so far.We're expecting new episodes of Invincible to be released at 7am GMT on 18 March.That works out to the following times around the world:3am ET (USA)2am CT (USA)12am (midnight) PT (USA)8am CET (Central Europe)3pm AWST on Sunday (Australia)5pm AEST on Sunday (Australia)Invincible season 4 will begin on 18 March on Prime Video - you can sign up now for a free 30-day Prime Video trial.Check out more of our Sci-fi coverage or visit our TV Guide and Streaming Guide to find out what's on. For more TV recommendations and reviews, listen to The Radio Times Podcast.AuthorsSci-Fi and Fantasy EditorLouise Griffin is the Sci-Fi & Fantasy Editor for Radio Times, covering everything from Doctor Who, Star Wars and Marvel to House of the Dragon and Good Omens. She previously worked at Metro as a Senior Entertainment Reporter and has a degree in English Literature.
